tokens.name: sala-0
tokens.usage: Page background: the darkened room. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: sala-1
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the collection hero, search field, license notes.

tokens.name: sala-2
tokens.usage: Posters without art, secondary buttons, hover fills, the player before it loads.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between sections. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, chips, secondary buttons): at least 3:1 on sala-0, sala-1 and sala-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on sala-0, sala-1, sala-2 and plata-soft. Also the fill of a selected chip.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (director, duration, year) and secondary copy, on sala-0, sala-1 and sala-2.

tokens.name: tungsteno
tokens.usage: Neon pink, the marquee light. The one action color: primary buttons, active states, the focus ring. Never decoration. (The token keeps its first name, tungsteno.)

tokens.name: tungsteno-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a primary button.

tokens.name: tungsteno-text
tokens.usage: Accent text (eyebrows, 'Ver todo' links) on sala-0, sala-1 and tungsteno-soft. An alias of tungsteno.

tokens.name: on-tungsteno
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tungsteno fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: tungsteno-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind tungsteno-text (accent badges such as 'Nuevo').

tokens.name: telon
tokens.usage: The curtain. Reserved for sponsored collections: their hero and their posters. Nothing else is wine.

tokens.name: on-telon
tokens.usage: All text and outlines on telon.

tokens.name: plata
tokens.usage: Silver screen. Legal and informational marks: license route, subtitle badges. As text on sala-0, sala-1 and plata-soft.

tokens.name: plata-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind plata text (info badges).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and broken embeds in the admin. Always with a word, never color alone.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Condensed poster capitals, like a title card. Always uppercase, used with restraint.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Collection hero title. One per screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Short title on its page and on the player.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next: designed for low vision, holds up across a room on a TV.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Cinco cortos que ganaron el Goya y se pueden ver gratis, de forma legal.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Director and secondary metadata, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Utility
groups.note: Timecode voice for numbers and labels.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Durations, always formatted with Intl (unit: minute).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, eyebrows and the sponsor credit label, uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; poster title to credit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between chips and buttons; poster padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards in a rail; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Component padding; poster perforation inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding; between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between rails on a page.

radius.note: Screens are rectangles: corners stay small.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, perforations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, posters, stills, cards, inputs. The largest corner on any media.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Filter chips only.

shadow.note: Light falls from the screen: shadows are deep and soft in the dark theme.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Posters at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Poster lifted on hover or focus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and TV-remote focus on every interactive element: a gap in sala-0, then a 2px tungsteno ring.

tokens.name: ratio-poster
tokens.usage: Posters and typographic posters in rails.

tokens.name: ratio-still
tokens.usage: Stills, the player and the collection hero art.
